en: Arcia - A messenger has arrived from Cutis: there has been large-scale violence there. When the Empire demanded crushing taxes in reprisal for the recent troubles, several villages refused, and they were destroyed by an Imperial attack that even used magic armor.
Draupnir - Hmm, is it true that they used magic armor?
Arcia - The report comes from our intelligence network at home, so it is almost certainly accurate. It seems at least two magic armors have appeared in Cutis.

Draupnir - If two of the five magic armors the Empire stationed in Pandragon have gone to Cutis, this could be a good chance for us. Your Highness, I think we should send our own magic armor to relieve Cutis.
Iyolin - So the plan is to strike while the enemy's magic armor is divided.

Draupnir - Exactly. We have three magic armors fit for battle; we have a good chance. And Pandragon has only three left to attack Astania with, so even if Astania is attacked, I believe its Templars can hold out until we defeat the Imperial army in Cutis and reach them.
Arcia - Either way, I hope we can drive the Imperial army out of Cutis this time.

Draupnir - With Beradin sending so many Imperial troops off to explore ruins, the Empire's military has never been weaker. If we crush the Imperial forces in Cutis and Astania now, we may not only retake Pandragon but even invade the Empire in turn.
Iyolin - In that case, we had better use the airship Lin Amadeo.

Draupnir - With the magic armor going, the airship is unavoidable. I will authorise the use of both. And for this operation, I think we should ask Prince Daicus of Castle Dagal to come with us as well.
